hotspot.finding: BM25 repeatedly tokenized identical System KB document text; user query tokenization was not the repeated corpus cost.

change.scope: bounded derived-text reuse for non-user System KB documents, including non-archived drafts reached by reindexing
change.key: exact non-user System KB searchable text
change.value: immutable tuple of exact lexical terms
change.invalidation: content-addressed key change plus LRU eviction; explicit maintenance clear is available
change.failure_policy: tokenizer failures retain the existing uncached bigram fallback and are never cached
change.privacy_boundary: user queries never call the document cache
change.ranking_boundary: BM25 continues to use _document_search_text and never substitutes PostgreSQL TSVECTOR representation

coverage: persistent tokenizer outage fallback is not cached
transient second-call tokenizer failure keeps the historical two-call bigram fallback

fixed_candidate_p_shard.purpose: post-fix result-set confirmation; not substituted into the original paired performance claim

limitations: one paired local sample and one hosted PR/main sample are not stable latency percentiles
the full main CI wall time includes runner scheduling, other shards, and finalization, so it is not wholly attributable to this cache
no test selection, retry, timeout, worker count, release policy, mobile artifact, or native code changed

safety_review.blocking_finding: the cached failure branch retried tokenization a third time after a transient second-call failure and could change BM25 terms
safety_review.fix: derive regex and bigram terms directly from an empty segmented result without another tokenizer call
safety_review.regression: first call succeeds, second call fails, a potential third call would recover; assert two calls and historical fallback terms
safety_review.scope_correction: the cache also serves non-archived System KB drafts during reindexing; no user query or user record is cached
safety_review.independent_matrix: all four success/failure combinations preserved parent terms and exactly two tokenizer calls
safety_review.privacy_probe: user query calls left both document caches unchanged
